I always want to trade futures and I have been all over the place with profits wiped out by losses. So I programmed a futures scanner on ES, NQ, CL, GC, BTC and ETH. 

I tried paper-trading using TradeStation API and a SIM paper trading account.  It needs more run.  The scanner show me which is tradable with ACT or WAIT.  With Action, it is either a Long or Short. Once a suggestion is clicked I then have a chart with marker on entry, TP and SL. 

Last two days results.
